title: The Gravity Room
setting_summary: Four strangers wake sealed inside a decommissioned orbital habitat module with a failing oxygen recycler and a countdown clock that no one set. Each holds a fragment of the access code needed to open the hatch, but the code only assembles if all four agree aloud on how to share the remaining air, water, and decision-making power. As the module drifts toward re-entry, every choice about dignity, speech, survival, and equality becomes a life-or-death negotiation.
